senses.en: a device or implement used to do a particular job

example.en: She picked up the right tool to tighten the loose bolt.
example.zh: 她拿起合适的工具拧紧松动的螺栓。

senses.en: to shape or work material with a tool

example.en: The craftsperson tooled the leather into a firm belt.
example.zh: 工匠把皮革加工成一条结实的腰带。

senses.en: a person or thing used by another to achieve an aim

example.en: Critics called the committee a tool of the industry.
example.zh: 批评者称该委员会是行业的工具。

senses.en: the front part of the body between the neck and the stomach

example.en: He put his hand on his chest and took a deep breath.
example.zh: 他把手放在胸口，深吸了一口气。

senses.en: a large strong box with a lid, used for storing things

example.en: The old letters were kept in a wooden chest.
example.zh: 那些旧信件存放在一个木箱里。

senses.en: money collected for a particular purpose, especially in politics or war

example.en: The campaign built a large war chest for the election.
example.zh: 该竞选团队为选举筹集了一大笔资金。

senses.en: the ability to use knowledge and experience to make good decisions

example.en: She showed great wisdom in waiting before making a decision.
example.zh: 她先等待再作决定，表现出极大的智慧。

senses.en: knowledge and teachings gained over time

example.en: The book draws on the wisdom of ancient cultures.
example.zh: 这本书汲取了古代文化的智慧。

senses.en: a wise saying or piece of advice

example.en: He shared a piece of wisdom from his grandmother.
example.zh: 他分享了一句祖母的至理名言。

senses.en: a thick warm cover used on a bed

example.en: She pulled the blanket up to her chin.

senses.en: a thick layer that covers something

example.en: A blanket of fog covered the valley.

senses.en: applying to all cases or people without exception

example.en: The city introduced a blanket ban on smoking.
example.zh: 该市出台了全面禁烟令。

senses.en: to cover something with a thick layer

example.en: Fresh snow blanketed the streets overnight.
example.zh: 一夜之间，新雪覆盖了街道。
